version: 17 Oct 2026 · page colour, pharmacy and lab
notes: Appointments now open first after you log in.
Smart Help: tap the Help button, type what you need (for example “holiday”) and it shows where it is and takes you there.
Hospitals: choose Dental hospital to use departments. Every patient can have a department, and the list can be filtered.
Pharmacy: new prescriptions appear in the Pharmacy list; chosen staff get a pop-up and sound.
Laboratory: dentists send lab requests from the patient's Lab tab; the lab marks them done with a result.
Fixed a style line so all screens look correct.
Settings → background: choose the colour of the whole page, or your own photo.
